hero.headline: Baked with Love in North West
hero.subheadline: Custom cakes and cupcakes made fresh daily by Lety Gibbon, using family recipes and local ingredients.

services.title: Custom Celebration Cakes
services.description: Tell us your vision for birthdays, weddings, or anniversaries. We create one-of-a-kind cakes with flavors and designs you choose, from classic vanilla to our signature North West honeycomb.

services.title: Cupcakes & Treats by the Dozen
services.description: Perfect for office parties, school events, or just because. Choose from our daily menu or order a custom batch with your favorite frosting and toppings.

services.title: Event Catering
services.description: We provide dessert tables and pastry platters for events across North West. We handle the setup so you can enjoy your party.
